marker.description: A green-headed pin is inserted into the surface of the liver.

main_question: Identify the organ indicated by the green pin.
main_explanation: The specimen shows the liver with the gallbladder and biliary tree. The pin is located on the large, reddish-brown organ which is the liver.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located in the gallbladder fossa on the visceral surface of the liver?
supporting_question.explanation: The gallbladder is situated in a depression (fossa) on the inferior (visceral) surface of the right lobe of the liver.
